# IMU Motion Analysis

Portfolio project by Utsav Patel for accelerometer and gyroscope time-series analysis.

## Main pages
- Overview: https://utsav7123.github.io/imu-motion-analysis/
- Methodology: https://utsav7123.github.io/imu-motion-analysis/methodology/
- Source: https://github.com/utsav7123/imu-motion-analysis

## Data source
The deployed analysis uses UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 755, Accelerometer Gyro Mobile Phone, licensed CC BY 4.0.

## Pipeline
The project validates raw IMU data, estimates sampling frequency, applies low-pass filtering, creates overlapping time windows, extracts time and frequency features, checks sensor quality, and compares Logistic Regression with Random Forest activity-classification baselines.
